versions.changelog: Fix fail-open contradictions in the guard guidance. (1) Troubleshooting told readers to 'serialize before testing' — the exact shape the body proves refuses only 3/6 hostile values; now prescribes type-check-first (6/6). (2) The 'Placeholder with no value' fix contradicted Rule 2's removal test and silently un-did scope cuts. (3) Sentinel gate scope was ambiguous between config and context — the shipped example's INSTALL_HOME sentinel exploited the gap; gate now walks both blocks. (4) Added the missing warn/strict two-mode spec that three hard gates already referenced. (5) INSTALL_HOME could never satisfy the no-sentinel hard gate in documented CLI-arg mode. (6) Fixed dead xref to Gotchas and a wrong 'next row' reference. (7) MEMORY.md and README.md were audited but absent from the anatomy tree. (8) requires.bins omitted node. (9) Scoped the *.bak-* .gitignore claim to what it actually covers. (10) Example questionnaire violated its own ASCII-only rule in a rendered value.

v1.0.1 — Republication. Contenu strictement identique a la 1.0.0 (SHA-256 verifie, aucun octet modifie).

Motif: la 1.0.0 n'etait jamais entree dans l'index de recherche du registre. Sa propre requete-slug exacte renvoyait 0 resultat, et elle etait absente du listing 'newest' alors que celui-ci remontait 22h avant sa publication.

1.0.0 — Initial release.

Replicate an agent across N contexts without drift: the questionnaire is the input contract, the sentinel marks what is not yet decided, and the generator refuses to deploy while one survives.

Shipped as a method with its traps rather than as a generator, because the guardrails are where this breaks. The sentinel gate is the one to get right — it is all that stands between an unknown legal basis and a live agent reading DMs — and the obvious repair is itself the bug: serialising a value to test it launders null into the empty string, which the regex then calls clean. Type-check first. Verified by execution: the serialise-then-test shape refuses 3 of 6 hostile values; the type-check-first shape refuses 6 of 6.

Also: a guard on the render path does not cover the purge path, and the path that bites is never the one you tested.
